reviewerSteps: On iPad or Apple TV, launch and choose Play immediately. Creating a player is optional.
Finish a race normally. Check actual result statistics, choose Rematch, and check a new race begins.
On iPad, choose Share, inspect the frozen actual image, open the native chooser and dismiss without posting.
On TV, choose Share. The actual frame/result card appears with local iPad handoff instructions. Real nearby-network handoff remains a manual check.
Create an optional player and use drawing/paint/customizer/track/scenery/controller functions. TV remote workshop routes are retained.
Open Game feel. Animation and Haptics begin On, are independently saved and retain Off across relaunch; OS Reduce Motion takes precedence.
rootReleaseGates: Scoped root visual approval of all21 native images is recorded. Prepare current gallery compositions separately; root retains release approval.
Choose/commit final source and exact version/build after fresh Apple record inspection; retain iPad+tvOS only.
Prepare current-source marketing gallery evidence; October3 source captures/packages are not the new launch/finish version.
Refresh support/privacy copy under the website dual-deployment policy; verify current URLs.
Archive/export the final committed revision with jobs2, verify signatures/provisioning/icons/privacy/entitlements/platform families and production test guards.
Upload and verify Apple processed builds; select exact builds for both supported platforms.
Verify accurate privacy label, review contact, free price, all eligible storefronts and current listing/reviewer notes; then submit.
